nxt: A group called the osteostracans developed large sensory fields on their heads and, importantly, paired fins at the front of the body.

title: The Invention of Jaws
text: Then came one of the biggest changes in vertebrate history. Most researchers think the jaw grew out of the first of the supporting arches that held up the gills.
nxt: Over time, those arches turned into hinged jaws that could grasp, bite, and crush.

title: Armored Kings with Jaws

nxt: One of the best known is Dunkleosteus, a giant several meters long with a head shield and bony blades in place of teeth.

title: Ice Over Gondwana
text: The Ordovician itself ended in a crisis. About four hundred and forty-four million years ago, ice sheets grew over Gondwana, and sea levels dropped.
nxt: Shallow seas, the home of many animals, shrank or vanished. Then conditions changed again, and parts of the ocean lost oxygen.
